mechanism: Atomoxetine inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing apixaban plasma concentrations since apixaban is metabolized via CYP3A4; additionally, atomoxetine has sympathomimetic effects that may increase cardiovascular risk in anticoagulated patients.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding and consider dose adjustment of apixaban if necessary; assess cardiovascular status regularly and counsel patients on bleeding precautions.
